why: eminence-v3's landbase, refixed: type-restricted fetches that reach the nine typed duals, replacing basic-only fetches and the life-taxing 5c lands. Land-for-land, 36 unchanged, so the spell configuration eminence-v3 was measured on is untouched.

staged.why: basic-only and enters tapped: 8 targets. Wooded Foothills is untapped and reaches all NINE typed duals plus 4 Mountain and 2 Forest — 15 targets, the widest reach of any fetch in the corpus against this list.
the other basic-only fetch. Arid Mesa reaches 7 typed duals plus 4 Mountain and the Plains — and W is short 5 with only one white basic to find.

Citadel charges 3 life EVERY tap. Scalding Tarn charges 1 once, and the shock it finds charges 2 once — after the first use the fetch is strictly cheaper, and it leaves a permanent dual behind. Reaches Steam Vents and Breeding Pool, which is the blue fix.

Orchard hands every opponent a 1/1 blocker each time it is tapped, in a deck whose objective is damage by T8. Bloodstained Mire is the only fetch reaching a Swamp type, so it is the deck's sole route to a black source.

same two colours as the Reef, minus the ping — and unlike the Reef it carries the Island and Mountain TYPES, so Scalding Tarn, Wooded Foothills and Arid Mesa can all find it. A painland is a dual that taxes you; the dual is the same card without the tax.

the Coast enters tapped early and serves a 4.4% blue splash. Plateau is untapped always, gives R (57.1% of pips) and W (short 5), and its Plains/Mountain types make it a target for Arid Mesa and Wooded Foothills — raising the typed-dual count from 9 to 11 and widening every fetch in the deck.

objective_history.why_changed: land_drop is `missed_land_drop_by_five`, a RATE where LOWER is better, so `>= 5.0` was wrong in both direction and scale and could never be met. keep_t3 is the castability measure a fixing change should move, and it must IMPROVE on v1.0.1's 0.866 rather than merely hold.
